items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: George Gaynor stayed until we just broke up almost.

ctx.x: Was he with you long? How long did he...

Oh yeah, he stayed with us a long time. George Gaynor stayed until we just broke up almost. He just said so wild and crazy. He can play pretty good banjo. I don't like the ghetto playing. He hits that old banjo so hard. Johnny had to build their dear What's the matter though? Everybody howl for the same long man, said, y'all better play. And every time we'd get on the stairs, that guy would go downstairs and we didn't know what it was all about. He cut that mic off, you see? So I seen him, I went downstairs, got…
Was there a guy killed on that same boat? Which boat was that? Huh? Which boat was this, anyway, that you played on? The steamer capitol. And was that a guy killed on the capitol?
